name: Vertex-Centric Asymmetric Accounting
description: Replaces the equality of a vertex-degree sum and an edge-cut sum (which easily gives away the 2E(S,S) = 0 independent-set reduction) with a single procedural loop over all vertices. Active vertices add their total degree to a register, while sleeping vertices subtract their active-neighbor count. This forces the model to algebraically reconstruct the global edge invariants from asymmetric local vertex operations before it can recognize the underlying independent-set constraint.
